objective: Define the parent-owned Book System lifecycle that governs book identity, canonical state, planning, drafting, evidence, child/lane services, version authority, author decisions, completion and export while reusing the recovered Book Intelligence and Prose capabilities behind explicit integration boundaries.

identity.book_project_id: immutable opaque identifier created once by Book System
identity.book_id: immutable opaque identifier for the authored work
identity.governing_brief_id: versioned parent artifact defining form, genre, audience, purpose, voice goals, constraints and explicit author intent
identity.rule: Display titles, filenames and chat names may change without changing book_project_id or book_id.

authority_classes.PARENT_CANONICAL: Book System parent has explicit canonical authority for this exact state/version.
authority_classes.AUTHOR_REQUIRED: Only explicit author decision may cross the boundary.
authority_classes.CHILD_PROPOSAL: Prose Project may supply bounded evidence/candidates but may not mutate parent canonical state.
authority_classes.EVALUATOR_EVIDENCE: Book Evaluator may provide independent findings/qualification evidence but may not mutate parent canonical state.
authority_classes.RESEARCH_EVIDENCE: Evidence may inform state but does not itself become canon or author intent.
authority_classes.HISTORICAL: Retained for provenance/rollback and not current authority.

required_inputs: source capability and source SHA/artifact identity
forbidden: in-place silent overwrite of canonical manuscript
automatic parent mutation from child branch output
discarding rejected or deferred candidate provenance

macro_services: whole-book Creative Excellence synthesis and hard gates
book_intelligence_service_model.rule: Parent Book System owns canonical lifecycle state; child/lane services receive bounded projections and return evidence/proposals. Service outputs are not canonical writes.

research_evidence_rules: Every material research claim attached to a book object must carry provenance and rights class.
Research evidence may be CURRENT, STALE, CONFLICTING, SUPERSEDED or UNKNOWN.
A changed source, contradiction or changed book requirement creates an invalidation/review candidate for dependent claims.
Research evidence cannot silently become canon, author intent or protected language.
Unknown provenance or rights blocks the affected integration.
author_decision_boundaries: promotion of a revision when configured author authority requires approval
any boundary separately marked AUTHOR_REQUIRED by child/lane contracts

freeze_requirements: one exact canonical manuscript version selected
required parent hard gates resolved or explicitly waived by authorized authority
rights/provenance checks complete for included material
completion_and_export.publication_rule: Export generation does not equal publication authorization. Publication/delivery that crosses the explicit author boundary requires recorded author authority.

fail_closed_rules: Unknown rights/provenance for affected material -> no admission.
Unresolved critical preservation regression -> retain current canonical version.
Required author decision missing -> queue AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED and do not synthesize approval.
Conflicting evaluator/specialist evidence -> preserve disagreement and defer or request bounded adjudication.
Child/lane blocker does not block unrelated Book System lifecycle work unless the parent dependency graph proves it is on the current parent critical path.
qualification_effect: NONE by creation. This contract defines parent lifecycle architecture but does not prove runtime implementation, A-01 qualification, human evidence, author decisions, production standing or publication authority.
